description.value: ChongQing on Robson is the downtown Vancouver outpost of a multi-location Szechuan Chinese restaurant chain that has operated in Vancouver for over twenty years. Located on busy Robson Street in the city centre, it specialises in traditional Szechuanese dishes and offers both dine-in and takeout. The central location puts it within easy reach of cyclists navigating the downtown core.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces, covered) at 75m; stands (2 spaces) at 88m; stands (2 spaces) at 96m; stands (5 spaces) at 99m. Total: 19 spaces.

The website confirms the business is actively operating as of 2025.
